recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-18564 unless the work group later reopens expansion lifecycle/status modeling; any future reconciliation of FHIR-14882 should treat FHIR-18564/GF#18685 as later superseding context.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive vocab issue asking to fix the old vsd-11 invariant requiring ValueSet.status = active when expansion is present and compose is absent, because an expansion might exist for a value set that is not active.
initial_application: No git commit was found that mentions FHIR-18564 directly. The Jira resolution points to GF#18685, and git commit fbcbcb6ac4f574b7f9859cc6bf36e54befb5d312 removed the old invariant from the historical ValueSet spreadsheet source. The old invariant had been introduced by GF#1488 / svn 13467 for the earlier FHIR-14882 status/expansion issue.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in the current build per source/fhir.ini. Current source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml no longer contains the old status/compose/expansion invariant; the vsd-11 key now belongs to an unrelated designation-use constraint. Current ValueSet.status text says status applies to compose and metadata while expansions do not have a state, and ValueSet.expansion says expansions are stateless. Zulip and Confluence evidence for GF#18685 confirms this was the intended Vocabulary WG resolution.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was needed because the current authoritative ValueSet source already reflects the seed issue.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue that introduced the old ValueSet status/expansion invariant later removed by FHIR-18564/GF#18685.
